title: Actively exploited sandbox RCE in all Chromium versions
summary: A critical remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability (CVE-2026-85046) has been discovered affecting all Chromium-based browsers, with evidence of active exploitation in the wild. This sandbox escape vulnerability poses severe security risks to users of Chrome, Edge, Brave, and other Chromium-based browsers.
problem_solved: Discloses and raises awareness of an actively exploited zero-day sandbox RCE vulnerability affecting all Chromium versions.
why_valuable: Critical security alert that enables organizations and users to take immediate action to patch and protect against an actively exploited browser vulnerability.
